text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—*Phew*… That's the set, Trainer.
Still, high knees in the sand are exceptionally brutal…
choice_data_list: Let's take a ten-minute break, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Understood.

With summer training camp underway, Biwa Hayahide was diligently working on
core training on the beach, aiming to elevate her baseline physical capabilities.

It was a flawless training regimen crafted together to ensure consistent future results.
However, entering the late stages of camp—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: *Huff*… *Pant*…! How was that, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you crushed your previous time! You've gotten steadily faster
compared to when camp started. Let's keep this momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: …! Yes, sir!

—This is the point where naturally intuitive horsegirls begin showing visible breakthroughs.
Naturally, Biwa Hayahide seemed keenly aware of that as well…

With official races just starting, it wouldn't be surprising if someone grew anxious
watching others undergo dramatic breakthroughs while they stuck to basic drills.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...I'm not quite sure what you mean, but there are no issues.
Now then, our ten minutes are up. Let us resume training.

True to her word, Biwa Hayahide steadfastly pushed through
her core training program according to plan—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...All right, that concludes today's entire routine.
Right on schedule, with zero deviations. Yes, absolutely perfect.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Thank you for your hard work as well, Trainer.
Shall we head back to the lodge, then?

...Seeing how composed she is, perhaps my worries were
completely unfounded after all. Just as that thought crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer. What does your schedule look like this evening?
choice_data_list: ...Did you want to discuss extra training?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You seem to think I am quite the training maniac.
Though, I suppose that isn't entirely inaccurate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was asking about your evening plans in the literal sense.
If you have nothing scheduled, there is somewhere I'd like you to accompany me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Come to think of it, ever since this camp began, I realized
we haven't had a single conversation unrelated to training adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It might be a bit early, but I thought we could talk while reviewing our progress.
...No, that's not right. Including a review blurs my actual premise.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, what I mean to say is...
—I would like to go to the summer festival with you.
*(Tap, tap, tap, tap... Snap!)*

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, tough luck! That fish tail is smashed to bits!
Better luck next time!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Drat... another failure. Theoretically, as long as I account for
the varying pressure along the grooves, clearing it should be simple...

Where Biwa Hayahide had led me was a summer festival
being held near the training camp lodge.

After enjoying a stroll around the stalls for a while,
the two of us decided to try our hand at Katanuki candy carving, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I resharpened the toothpick. My dust mitigation was flawless.
Which means... the issue lies in my force modulation after all.
choice_data_list: Maybe you're tensing up your shoulders too much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It seems you're right. Because my theory is so sound,
whenever things go wrong, I become overly frustrated and heated.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, no matter how flawless the formula constructed,
if one's own skill cannot execute it, it remains nothing more than a string of numbers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Those with innate talent who also put in the work... like my sister, for instance,
could likely prove such formulas in the shortest possible time.

Biwa Hayahide cast her gaze gently upward. Looking up with her, the night sky held
both dazzlingly bright stars and tiny ones you could barely notice unless you strained your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She wouldn't care which path she took. No matter how steep the climb,
she would hone those magnificent legs she was born with... and reach the very top.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I, however, am different. Only by calculating the shortest path, removing every obstacle,
and perfecting the running conditions can I finally... stand at the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet—that is perfectly fine.
After all, this is simply "who I am."

There wasn't a trace of resignation in Biwa Hayahide's gentle smile.
It was the serene smile of someone who had faced herself and fully embraced what she saw.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because I had nothing extraordinary to start with, all I could do was struggle.
And so, I forged theory into my weapon, polished it, and became the person I am today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —The person whom you acknowledged, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this is fine. Even if I cannot reach my goal immediately,
I will trust in my weapon and push forward methodically. That is my path.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In short, what I wanted to say was that there is no need to worry.
Both mentally and physically, I am growing stronger with each passing day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And with that said, I will conquer this candy carving without fail.
Victory is already in sight. This time, I will claim it with absolute certainty!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me!
And then, after several more attempts, at long last—!
*(Tap, tap, tap... Tap.)*

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah...! It's done!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer!
Look, it carved out perfectly cleanly!

text_block_list.name: Stall Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's incredible! That's the cleanest job I've ever seen!
You kept your cool and pulled off a win through sheer grit!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Indeed.
Continuing to challenge the problem until deriving the perfect solution is my aesthetic, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you agree, Trainer?
Heheh...
And finally, the last day of the training camp arrived.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Haaaaah—!

During the time trial to measure her development,
Biwa Hayahide put on a dazzling display of speed that blew away all expectations...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Well, Trainer?
Now that all the data is in... have I met the target metrics?
choice_data_list: You cleared every single one! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It appears dedicating ourselves to the fundamentals paid off.
As I thought, this methodology suits me best.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is the formula for growth leading to victory
that we discovered together.

The horizon stretched out far ahead in Biwa Hayahide's focused gaze.
Though distant, there is no doubt that one day, she will reach it.
—To the perfection of her "Formula for Victory"!
